unit: East Asian Legal Studies Program (Harvard HLS)

labs.pi_title: Director of East Asian Legal Studies; Jerome A. and Joan L. Cohen Professor of East Asian Legal Studies
labs.location: Austin Hall 301, 1585 Massachusetts Ave., Cambridge, MA 02138 (office temporarily on the fifth floor of Areeda Hall, June to November 2026)
labs.research_summary: Harvard Law School program that supports research and teaching on the law and legal history of East Asia and its place in global order, with a visiting scholar program and student grants.
labs.join_notes: Student Opportunities page says students can work as research assistants or teaching fellows for EALS faculty, among other options; it names no contact or opening. The site also has a Visiting Scholar Program.
labs.notes: Alice Izumo is Associate Director; her email is hidden. Staff: Juliet Bowler (Senior Program Manager, HPOD and EALS), Emma Johnson (program staff). Faculty affiliates (Idriss Fofana, J. Mark Ramseyer, Mark Wu) not counted. The contact page shows eals [at] law.harvard.edu, recorded in normal form as the general address.
